verdict.rationale: Extend offers some many-item processing: multifile extraction runs one extraction over a collection of files, evaluation set runs score a processor against every item in a set, and async mode on every processing endpoint plus webhooks supports high-volume pipelines. However, the evidence never documents a general batch or bulk API for processing or managing many documents in one call. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk processing endpoint, bulk operations via CLI/MCP, documented limits and throughput for bulk jobs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
